# Security Policy

This repository is the static landing page for FreeBus. It has no server, no
accounts and no user data. A vulnerability here is most likely something
like a script injection or a dependency issue in the built site.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability.**

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:

1. Go to the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the issue, how to reproduce it, and its impact.

If you can't use that flow, contact the maintainer,
[@ShalomSagi](https://github.com/ShalomSagi), privately through GitHub.

Issues in the FreeBus app, API or data pipeline belong to the
[main repository](https://github.com/freebus-co-il/freebus/security).
